pool.note: Surface presentation impressions/behaviours; every line is colour.

rows.text: Genuinely helpful, or indistinguishable from it. Knowledgeable, generous with information, nothing that raises concern.
Volunteers information before you ask. Seems invested in your success here.
Friendly and community-minded. The kind of person other residents speak well of.
Knows everyone, introduces you to people, seems like the natural first contact for newcomers.
Warm, a little effusive. The first person to make you feel you've arrived somewhere safe.
Asks good questions about your journey. Remembers the answers.
Efficient and correct in every interaction. The manner of someone following procedure.
Processes requests quickly. Doesn't ask about things that aren't their business.
Reserved. Appropriately cautious with strangers. You would be too, in their position.
Asks reasonable questions. Gives reasonable answers. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Busy. The impression of someone with real responsibilities who is giving you an appropriate portion of their attention.
Helpful within the limits of their role. Refers you to others for anything outside it.
Unremarkable. The particular invisible quality of someone who has spent years not being noticed.
Answers questions. Asks nothing. Remembers more than they show.
Tired and ordinary. The manner of someone who is carrying less than they are.
Quiet, neighbourly. The impression of someone with a small life and modest concerns.
Helpful in the small practical ways that don't invite scrutiny.
